ex.en: When listening to a lecture, you should be quiet.
ex.zh: 聽演講時要保持安靜。

ex.en: The old professor's lectures are long-winded and ponderous.
ex.zh: 那位老教授的課又長又沉悶。

ex.en: Anyone can attend my lectures, but not everyone can understand them.
ex.zh: 誰都可以來聽我的課，但不是每個人都聽得懂。

ex.en: Stop lecturing me about my spending.
ex.zh: 別再對我的花錢習慣說教了。

ex.en: My dad lectured me for coming home late.
ex.zh: 我晚回家被爸爸訓了一頓。

ex.en: I often spend my leisure time listening to the radio.
ex.zh: 我常常在閒暇時聽廣播。

ex.en: She spends her leisure time making dolls.
ex.zh: 她利用空閒時間做娃娃。

leisure.zh: at one's leisure：在方便、有空的時候

ex.en: Please read the report at your leisure.
ex.zh: 請在您方便時閱讀這份報告。

ex.en: You can reply at your leisure.
ex.zh: 你有空再回覆就好。

ex.en: The meeting was lengthy and boring.
ex.zh: 這場會議又長又無聊。

ex.en: The visa application involves a lengthy process.
ex.zh: 申請簽證的流程很漫長。

ex.en: After a lengthy discussion, we reached an agreement.
ex.zh: 經過冗長的討論，我們終於達成協議。

ex.en: We were deeply impressed by the lecturer's eloquent speech.
ex.zh: 演講者精彩的演說讓我們印象深刻。

ex.en: She is a lecturer at a university in Taipei.
ex.zh: 她在台北一所大學擔任講師。

ex.en: The lecturer answered questions after class.
ex.zh: 講師在下課後回答問題。

letterhead.zh: 印有公司抬頭的信紙；信紙抬頭

ex.en: Please print the letter on company letterhead.
ex.zh: 請把這封信印在公司的抬頭信紙上。

ex.en: The letterhead shows our address and phone number.
ex.zh: 信紙抬頭印有我們的地址和電話。

ex.en: The lender approved our mortgage application.
ex.zh: 貸款機構核准了我們的房貸申請。

ex.en: Compare interest rates from different lenders.
ex.zh: 比較不同貸款機構的利率。

ex.en: The accountant recorded the payment in the ledger.
ex.zh: 會計把這筆付款記在帳簿上。

ex.en: Please check the general ledger for errors.
ex.zh: 請檢查總帳有沒有錯誤。

ex.en: The lessee must pay rent on the first of each month.
ex.zh: 承租人必須在每月一日繳租金。

ex.en: The lessee is responsible for minor repairs.
ex.zh: 小型維修由承租人負責。

ex.en: The lessor is responsible for major repairs.
ex.zh: 重大維修由出租人負責。

ex.en: The lease must be signed by both the lessor and the lessee.
ex.zh: 租約必須由出租人和承租人雙方簽署。

ex.en: You must be 18 to drive legally here.
ex.zh: 在這裡要滿 18 歲才能合法開車。

ex.en: The software must be legally purchased.
ex.zh: 軟體必須合法購買。

ex.en: The contract is legally binding.
ex.zh: 這份合約具有法律約束力。

ex.en: Legally, the landlord must return your deposit.
ex.zh: 依法房東必須退還你的押金。

ex.en: Is this a legitimate business?
ex.zh: 這是合法的生意嗎？

ex.en: Make sure the website is legitimate before you pay.
ex.zh: 付款前先確認網站是正規的。

ex.en: That's a legitimate question.
ex.zh: 那是個合理的問題。

ex.en: She had a legitimate reason for being late.
ex.zh: 她遲到有正當理由。

ex.en: The new hospital will be his legacy.
ex.zh: 這家新醫院將是他留給後人的貢獻。

ex.en: Her legacy lives on in her work.
ex.zh: 她的影響在作品中延續下去。

legacy.zh: （系統、資料）舊有的、沿用下來的

ex.en: We still use some legacy systems.
ex.zh: 我們仍在使用一些舊系統。

ex.en: Migrating legacy data takes time.
ex.zh: 轉移舊有資料需要時間。

ex.en: The government plans to levy a tax on sugary drinks.
ex.zh: 政府計畫對含糖飲料課稅。

ex.en: A fee is levied on all imported goods.
ex.zh: 所有進口商品都要徵收一筆費用。

ex.en: The city introduced a levy on plastic bags.
ex.zh: 市政府開始對塑膠袋收費。

ex.en: Airlines pay a levy on every ticket sold.
ex.zh: 航空公司每賣出一張機票都要繳一筆稅費。

ex.en: In Algeria, thousands of people are running for the June 2021 legislative elections.
ex.zh: 在阿爾及利亞，數千人參加 2021 年 6 月的國會選舉。

ex.en: The legislative process can take years.
ex.zh: 立法程序可能要花上好幾年。

ex.en: The bill was sent to the Legislative Yuan for review.
ex.zh: 這項法案已送交立法院審查。

ex.en: Other factors played a lesser role.
ex.zh: 其他因素的影響較小。

ex.en: He accepted a lesser position in the company.
ex.zh: 他接受了公司裡一個較低的職位。

lesser.zh: to a lesser extent：程度較輕地

ex.en: Sales fell in Europe and, to a lesser extent, in Asia.
ex.zh: 歐洲的銷售下滑，亞洲也略有下滑。

ex.en: This affects young people and, to a lesser extent, older adults.
ex.zh: 這主要影響年輕人，對年長者的影響較小。

ex.en: The lawyer questioned the legitimacy of the contract.
ex.zh: 律師質疑這份合約的合法性。

ex.en: Customer reviews give a new brand legitimacy.
ex.zh: 顧客評價能讓新品牌更有公信力。

ex.en: I was about to leave when the doorbell rang.
ex.zh: 門鈴響的時候，我正要出門。

ex.en: It's high time you left for school, isn't it?
ex.zh: 你差不多該去上學了吧？

ex.en: She went shopping, leaving her little child all alone.
ex.zh: 她去購物，把小孩獨自留在家裡。

ex.en: I left my phone in the taxi.
ex.zh: 我把手機忘在計程車上了。

ex.en: He always leaves the window open while he sleeps.
ex.zh: 他睡覺時總是開著窗戶。

ex.en: Please leave the door open.
ex.zh: 請讓門開著。

ex.en: She is on maternity leave.
ex.zh: 她正在休產假。

ex.en: I'm taking two days of leave next week.
ex.zh: 我下週要請兩天假。

ex.en: He lets his workers eat meals in the office.
ex.zh: 他讓員工在辦公室吃飯。

ex.en: She always lets her children do what they want to.
ex.zh: 她總是讓孩子做他們想做的事。

ex.en: Let's take a short break.
ex.zh: 我們休息一下吧。

ex.en: Let's discuss this tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我們明天再討論這件事吧。

let.zh: let me know：告訴我、讓我知道

ex.en: Let me know if you have any questions.
ex.zh: 有任何問題請告訴我。

ex.en: Please let me know by Friday.
ex.zh: 請在星期五前告訴我。

ex.en: Tom is an archaeologist leading the excavations near Rome.
ex.zh: 湯姆是考古學家，正在羅馬附近帶領挖掘工作。

ex.en: She will lead the sales team next year.
ex.zh: 她明年將帶領業務團隊。

ex.en: Do you know which road leads to my house?
ex.zh: 你知道哪條路通往我家嗎？

ex.en: This road will lead you to the airport.
ex.zh: 這條路會帶你到機場。

ex.en: Harmony in the family leads to success in everything.
ex.zh: 家庭和睦能帶來各方面的成功。

ex.en: Poor planning can lead to serious delays.
ex.zh: 規劃不當可能導致嚴重延誤。

ex.en: He is leading an easy life in the country.
ex.zh: 他在鄉下過著悠閒的生活。

ex.en: He led a hard life after that.
ex.zh: 從那之後，他過著艱苦的生活。

ex.en: Our company has a clear lead in the market.
ex.zh: 我們公司在市場上明顯領先。

ex.en: The team took the lead in the second half.
ex.zh: 這支隊伍在下半場取得領先。

ex.en: I'm trying to spend less money on food.
ex.zh: 我正試著少花點錢在吃的上面。

ex.en: We have less time than we thought.
ex.zh: 我們的時間比想像中少。

ex.en: It is less cold today than it was yesterday.
ex.zh: 今天沒有昨天那麼冷。

ex.en: You should worry less about small things.
ex.zh: 你應該少為小事擔心。

ex.en: I finished the work in less than an hour.
ex.zh: 我不到一小時就完成了這項工作。

ex.en: The hotel is less than five minutes away.
ex.zh: 飯店距離這裡不到五分鐘。

ex.en: Everyone was more or less interested in the arts.
ex.zh: 每個人多少都對藝術有興趣。

ex.en: The project is more or less finished.
ex.zh: 這個專案大致上完成了。

ex.en: You'll learn how to do it sooner or later.
ex.zh: 你遲早會學會怎麼做。

ex.en: He started learning English at the age of eleven.
ex.zh: 他十一歲開始學英文。

ex.en: It is not easy to learn a foreign language.
ex.zh: 學外語不容易。

ex.en: I was surprised to learn that she had quit.
ex.zh: 得知她辭職了，我很驚訝。

ex.en: We learned about the change from an email.
ex.zh: 我們是從一封電子郵件得知這項變動的。

ex.en: Her acting is on the level of a professional.
ex.zh: 她的演技有專業水準。

ex.en: The course is designed for students at an advanced level.
ex.zh: 這門課是為程度較高的學生設計的。

ex.en: The town is situated 1,500 meters above sea level.
ex.zh: 這個小鎮位於海拔 1,500 公尺。

ex.en: As global warming increases, sea levels get higher and higher.
ex.zh: 隨著全球暖化加劇，海平面越來越高。

ex.en: The parking lot is on level B2.
ex.zh: 停車場在 B2 樓層。

ex.en: The food court is on the top level.
ex.zh: 美食街在最頂樓。

ex.en: We must sleep at least eight hours a day.
ex.zh: 我們每天至少要睡八小時。

ex.en: There are at least thirty students in our class.
ex.zh: 我們班至少有三十個學生。

ex.en: Eggs should be boiled for at least five minutes.
ex.zh: 雞蛋至少要煮五分鐘。

ex.en: This is the least expensive option.
ex.zh: 這是最便宜的選項。

ex.en: Problems always happen when you least expect them.
ex.zh: 問題總是在你最意想不到的時候發生。

least.zh: not in the least：一點也不

ex.en: I am not in the least afraid of dogs.
ex.zh: 我一點也不怕狗。

ex.en: I didn't understand in the least what he said.
ex.zh: 他說的話我完全聽不懂。

ex.en: I wrote five letters before I went to bed.
ex.zh: 睡前我寫了五封信。

ex.en: Excuse me for not having answered your letter sooner.
ex.zh: 抱歉沒有早點回你的信。

ex.en: You shouldn't read other people's private letters without permission.
ex.zh: 未經允許不應該看別人的私人信件。

ex.en: Your password must contain capital letters.
ex.zh: 你的密碼必須包含大寫字母。

ex.en: The word starts with the letter B.
ex.zh: 這個字是 B 開頭的。

ex.en: We need competent leaders.
ex.zh: 我們需要有能力的領導者。

ex.en: A wise leader knows when to listen to others.
ex.zh: 聰明的領導者知道什麼時候該聽取別人的意見。

ex.en: She is the leader of our team.
ex.zh: 她是我們團隊的組長。

ex.en: Japan is a leader in the world's high-tech industry.
ex.zh: 日本是全球高科技產業的領先者。

ex.en: The company is a market leader in smartphones.
ex.zh: 這家公司是智慧型手機市場的龍頭。

ex.en: Roger slipped on the ice and hurt his leg.
ex.zh: 羅傑在冰上滑倒，傷了腿。

ex.en: My leg was broken in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 我在一場車禍中摔斷了腿。

ex.en: I'm on crutches since I broke both my legs.
ex.zh: 自從兩條腿都斷了，我就一直拄著拐杖。

ex.en: The first leg of our trip is from Taipei to Tokyo.
ex.zh: 我們旅程的第一段是從台北到東京。

ex.en: The last leg of the tour was in Paris.
ex.zh: 巡迴的最後一站在巴黎。

ex.en: He broke his left arm.
ex.zh: 他的左手臂骨折了。

ex.en: Take the left lane at the next exit.
ex.zh: 下一個出口請走左側車道。

ex.en: Turn left at the traffic light.
ex.zh: 在紅綠燈左轉。

ex.en: The bank is on your left.
ex.zh: 銀行在你的左手邊。

left.zh: （leave 的過去式）離開、留下；（be left）剩下

ex.en: I may have left my umbrella in the bus.
ex.zh: 我可能把雨傘忘在公車上了。

ex.en: The wet vase left a mark on the table.
ex.zh: 濕花瓶在桌上留下了水痕。

ex.en: There are only two seats left.
ex.zh: 只剩兩個位子了。

ex.en: At that time, I was still taking French lessons.
ex.zh: 那時候我還在上法文課。

ex.en: My sister takes piano lessons twice a week.
ex.zh: 我妹妹每週上兩次鋼琴課。

ex.en: They have English lessons three times a week.
ex.zh: 他們每週上三堂英文課。

ex.en: I hope that Tom has learned his lesson.
ex.zh: 希望湯姆已經學到教訓了。

ex.en: The failure taught us an important lesson.
ex.zh: 這次失敗給了我們重要的教訓。

ex.en: I don't know the exact length of this bridge.
ex.zh: 我不知道這座橋確切的長度。

ex.en: The length of this ship is 30 meters.
ex.zh: 這艘船的長度是 30 公尺。

ex.en: The river is 300 kilometers in length.
ex.zh: 那條河全長 300 公里。

ex.en: The length of the meeting depends on the agenda.
ex.zh: 會議時間的長短取決於議程。

ex.en: Please keep your speech to a reasonable length.
ex.zh: 請把演講控制在合理的長度內。

length.zh: at length：詳細地、長篇大論地

ex.en: We discussed the problem at length.
ex.zh: 我們詳細地討論了這個問題。

ex.en: He talked at length about his travels.
ex.zh: 他滔滔不絕地談起他的旅行。

ex.en: The students admire her leadership skills.
ex.zh: 學生們很欣賞她的領導能力。

ex.en: Tom was born with leadership ability.
ex.zh: 湯姆天生具有領導能力。

ex.en: The company's leadership has approved the plan.
ex.zh: 公司高層已經核准了這個計畫。

ex.en: There was a change in leadership last year.
ex.zh: 去年領導階層有了變動。

ex.en: He was leaning against the wall.
ex.zh: 他靠在牆上。

ex.en: Don't lean against the wall.
ex.zh: 別靠在牆上。

ex.en: Lend me your shoulder for me to lean on.
ex.zh: 借我你的肩膀靠一下。

ex.en: The tower leaned slightly to the west.
ex.zh: 那座塔稍微向西傾斜。

ex.en: She leaned forward to hear better.
ex.zh: 她身體往前傾，好聽得更清楚。

ex.en: I prefer lean meat.
ex.zh: 我比較喜歡瘦肉。

ex.en: The company wants to stay lean and efficient.
ex.zh: 公司希望維持精簡、有效率。

ex.en: If you want a pencil, I'll lend you one.
ex.zh: 如果你需要鉛筆，我借你一支。

ex.en: Would you mind lending me your car?
ex.zh: 你介意把車借給我嗎？

ex.en: He still hasn't given me the money I lent him.
ex.zh: 我借他的錢，他到現在還沒還我。

ex.en: The bank refused to lend us the money.
ex.zh: 銀行拒絕借錢給我們。

ex.en: Banks are lending less to small businesses.
ex.zh: 銀行對小型企業的放款減少了。

ex.en: Could you lend me a hand with these boxes?
ex.zh: 你可以幫我搬這些箱子嗎？

ex.en: My neighbor is always willing to lend a hand.
ex.zh: 我的鄰居總是樂於幫忙。

ex.en: All the top teams in England are in the Premier League.
ex.zh: 英格蘭所有頂尖球隊都在英超聯賽。

ex.en: He plays in a local basketball league.
ex.zh: 他在當地的籃球聯賽打球。

ex.en: Tom is out of your league.
ex.zh: 湯姆跟你不是同一個等級的。

ex.en: As a chef, she is in a different league.
ex.zh: 身為廚師，她的水準高出一截。

ex.en: Ken leapt over the wall.
ex.zh: 肯跳過了牆。

ex.en: That runner leaped over the hole in the ground.
ex.zh: 那名跑者躍過了地上的洞。

ex.en: The new software is a huge leap forward.
ex.zh: 這套新軟體是一大躍進。

ex.en: There was a leap in sales after the ad campaign.
ex.zh: 廣告活動後銷售額大幅躍升。

ex.en: Artificial leather can't compare with the real thing.
ex.zh: 人造皮革比不上真皮。

ex.en: These boots are made of leather.
ex.zh: 這雙靴子是皮革做的。

ex.en: My wallet is made of leather.
ex.zh: 我的錢包是皮製的。

ex.en: Tom bought a pair of black leather shoes.
ex.zh: 湯姆買了一雙黑色皮鞋。

ex.en: I bought a pair of leather gloves.
ex.zh: 我買了一雙皮手套。

ex.en: These green leaves turn red or yellow in fall.
ex.zh: 這些綠葉到了秋天會變紅或變黃。

ex.en: A fallen leaf floated on the surface of the water.
ex.zh: 一片落葉漂浮在水面上。

ex.en: A dead leaf fell to the ground.
ex.zh: 一片枯葉掉到了地上。

leaf.zh: turn over a new leaf：改過自新、重新開始

ex.en: I'll turn over a new leaf and study English very hard.
ex.zh: 我會改過自新，努力學英文。

ex.en: After the New Year, he decided to turn over a new leaf.
ex.zh: 新年過後，他決定重新做人。

ex.en: She leafed through the catalog.
ex.zh: 她快速翻閱了目錄。

ex.en: I leafed through a few magazines in the waiting room.
ex.zh: 我在候診室翻了幾本雜誌。

ex.en: Myths and legends should be handed down from generation to generation.
ex.zh: 神話和傳說應該一代一代傳承下去。

ex.en: Legend has it that the lake has no bottom.
ex.zh: 傳說這座湖深不見底。

ex.en: He is a legend in the music industry.
ex.zh: 他是音樂界的傳奇人物。

ex.en: Michael Jordan is a basketball legend.
ex.zh: 麥可・喬丹是籃球傳奇。

ex.en: Check the legend to see what each color means.
ex.zh: 看一下圖例，了解每種顏色代表什麼。

ex.en: The map legend explains the symbols.
ex.zh: 地圖的圖例說明了各個符號。

ex.en: Pull the lever to open the door.
ex.zh: 拉下拉桿就能把門打開。

ex.en: Use a lever to lift the heavy rock.
ex.zh: 用槓桿抬起那塊大石頭。

ex.en: They used the contract as a lever to get better prices.
ex.zh: 他們拿合約當籌碼，爭取更好的價格。

ex.en: Tax cuts are a lever to boost spending.
ex.zh: 減稅是刺激消費的一種手段。

ex.en: The test measures students' lexical knowledge.
ex.zh: 這項測驗評量學生的詞彙知識。

ex.en: This app helps learners expand their lexical range.
ex.zh: 這個 App 幫助學習者擴大詞彙量。

ex.en: Tom fed his leftovers to his dog.
ex.zh: 湯姆把吃剩的拿去餵狗。

ex.en: I fed the leftovers to my dog.
ex.zh: 我把剩菜拿去餵狗。

ex.en: Every time it rains, the roof leaks.
ex.zh: 每次下雨屋頂就漏水。

ex.en: The roof leaks in 3 different places.
ex.zh: 屋頂有三個地方在漏水。

ex.en: The explosion may have been caused by a gas leak.
ex.zh: 這場爆炸可能是瓦斯外洩造成的。

ex.en: There's a leak under the kitchen sink.
ex.zh: 廚房水槽下面在漏水。

ex.en: His secretary denied leaking the information.
ex.zh: 他的祕書否認洩漏了消息。

ex.en: Don't let this information leak out.
ex.zh: 別讓這個消息洩漏出去。

ex.en: He is a learned man who has read thousands of books.
ex.zh: 他是個讀過上千本書、學識淵博的人。

ex.en: The journal publishes articles by learned scholars.
ex.zh: 這份期刊刊登學識淵博的學者所寫的文章。

ex.en: A lethal dose of the drug can stop the heart.
ex.zh: 這種藥如果服用致死劑量，可能讓心臟停止跳動。

ex.en: The virus is lethal to people with weak immune systems.
ex.zh: 這種病毒對免疫力差的人是致命的。

ex.en: I am lesbian.
ex.zh: 我是女同性戀。

ex.en: I'm a lesbian.
ex.zh: 我是女同性戀。

ex.en: My aunt is a lesbian, and she lives happily with her partner.
ex.zh: 我阿姨是女同性戀者，她和伴侶過得很幸福。

ex.en: The film tells the story of a lesbian couple raising two children.
ex.zh: 這部電影講述一對女同志伴侶養育兩個孩子的故事。

ex.en: She joined a lesbian support group at her university.
ex.zh: 她在大學參加了一個女同志支持團體。

ex.en: The legislature passed the new law last week.
ex.zh: 立法機關上週通過了新法。

ex.en: Taiwan's legislature is called the Legislative Yuan.
ex.zh: 台灣的立法機關叫做立法院。

ex.en: The legal system in America is the world's finest.
ex.zh: 美國的司法制度是世界上最好的。

ex.en: Lawyers will urge the parents to take further legal action.
ex.zh: 律師會勸家長採取進一步的法律行動。

ex.en: Legal terminology is not comprehensible to most laypeople.
ex.zh: 大多數外行人看不懂法律術語。

ex.en: Is it legal to park here?
ex.zh: 在這裡停車合法嗎？

ex.en: The legal drinking age in Taiwan is 18.
ex.zh: 台灣的法定飲酒年齡是 18 歲。

ex.en: The President of the United States has the power to veto and send back legislation.
ex.zh: 美國總統有權否決法案並將其退回。

ex.en: New legislation will ban single-use plastic bags.
ex.zh: 新法將禁止一次性塑膠袋。

ex.en: I signed the lease today.
ex.zh: 我今天簽了租約。

ex.en: The lease ends in June.
ex.zh: 租約六月到期。

ex.en: The company leases its office space.
ex.zh: 公司的辦公室是租來的。

ex.en: We lease cars to businesses.
ex.zh: 我們出租汽車給企業。

ex.en: Please make sure your signature is legible.
ex.zh: 請確保您的簽名清晰易讀。

ex.en: The scanned document is clear and legible.
ex.zh: 掃描的文件清楚易讀。

ex.en: She requested a letter of recommendation from her manager.
ex.zh: 她請經理為她寫一封推薦信。

ex.en: The application requires a letter of recommendation.
ex.zh: 這份申請需要附上一封推薦信。

ex.en: Both companies signed a letter of intent.
ex.zh: 兩家公司簽署了意向書。

ex.en: The letter of intent outlines the proposed partnership.
ex.zh: 意向書概述了擬議中的合作關係。

lead time.zh: 前置時間；訂貨至交貨所需時間

ex.en: The lead time for custom parts is six weeks.
ex.zh: 訂製零件的交貨前置時間是六週。

ex.en: Please confirm the lead time before approving the order.
ex.zh: 核准訂單前請先確認交貨所需時間。

ex.en: The seller requested a letter of credit before shipping.
ex.zh: 賣方要求在出貨前提供信用狀。

ex.en: Our bank issued a letter of credit for the purchase.
ex.zh: 我們的銀行為這筆採購開立了信用狀。

ex.en: We don't have much leverage in this negotiation.
ex.zh: 我們在這次談判中沒有什麼籌碼。

ex.en: Being the only supplier gives them leverage.
ex.zh: 身為唯一的供應商讓他們握有籌碼。

ex.en: We can leverage our experience in Asia.
ex.zh: 我們可以善用我們在亞洲的經驗。

ex.en: The company leveraged social media to grow quickly.
ex.zh: 這家公司借助社群媒體快速成長。
